thread:
nina: Quick one — we're consolidating partner inputs for the cost model and SI marketplace listing. Need a single CSV payload from partners that covers reserved, spot, credits, and any release/penalty curves. Deadline Fri EOD.

omar: Can we be explicit about time-series format? Prefer csv with two cols: iso8601, price_usd. 7-14 days ideal.

sophie: Add fields for marketplace surcharge (pct) and channel partner margin (pct) — SI deals sometimes embed an extra fee.

devon: Minimal CSV header suggestion:```
sku,vendor,region,instance_sku,gpu_type,vcpu,memory_gb,reserved_hourly_usd,reserved_term_months,reserved_guarantee_pct,reserved_early_release_penalty_curve_link,spot_hourly_mean_usd,spot_p10_usd,spot_p50_usd,spot_p90_usd,spot_timeseries_link,eviction_rate_pct_per_day,eviction_notice_seconds,eviction_credit_type,eviction_credit_value,eviction_min_running_seconds_for_credit,marketplace_surcharge_pct,channel_margin_pct,billing_granularity_seconds,timezone,availability_notes,notes
```

devon: Example rows to paste:```
sku-nx1,BlueRack,us-east-1,nx1-96,A100-80GB,96,1536,11.50,12,98,https://s3.example.com/blue/penalty_curve.csv,3.20,2.5,3.0,4.5,https://s3.example.com/blue/spot-14d.csv,0.4,300,hourly_credit,15,180,2.0,5.0,60,UTC,24x7,"reserved guaranteed, channel margin applies to committed usage"
sku-lite-7,EdgeServe,ap-northeast-1,es-gpu-48,V100-32GB,48,512,7.25,6,85,,1.10,0.9,1.05,1.4,https://s3.example.com/edge/spot-7d.csv,1.8,120,monthly_rebate,50,300,0.0,8.0,60,JST,Business-hours only,
```

rahul: For penalty curves, a small CSV with (units_released, penalty_usd) is enough. If partners only give a formula (eg linear) that's fine.

omar: Ops note: indicate if reserved capacity is pre-seeded for SI installs (private racks) vs shared pool. That's a boolean flag we should add if possible.

sophie: Legal: ask partners whether credits require a manual claim and what evidence they accept. Add 'credit_claim_required' and 'credit_proof_format' fields.

partner-bot: Upload: outreach/templates/hw_cost_input_v1.csv :white_check_mark:

nina: Great. I'll draft outreach and include the example rows + a short doc on how we convert percentiles/time-series into simulation inputs. We'll lock on Fri 10am sync to review replies. Thanks all.
